role: Command sources for agent mode: a JSONL script, a tape to replay (read and parsed ahead on its own thread), or the TCP control port on 127.0.0.1 (the Malmo replacement); one JSON object per line in and out, consumed on the client thread through a queue; lastLine keeps the text a replay row was parsed from for the row compare.
notes: The word Control in oracle/src/tileentity/TileEntity.java is the command block's registry name, not a hook. stop() ends a replay's reader thread, closes the script and drops queued commands between pool runs.
